observations: Photo 0: Front view of a dark-colored smartphone with a cracked screen, held in hand. The screen has multiple visible cracks and smudges. The top edge shows a notch typical of iPhone models.
Photo 1: Back view of the same phone, showing a triple-camera system in a square module, Apple logo centered, and a dark gray or space gray finish. The design matches iPhone 12 Pro.
Photo 2: Another front view, similar to photo 0, with the same cracked screen and smudges. The phone is held against a background with 'STRONG & BOLD TELECOMS' text.
All photos show the same phone from different angles. No model number or serial is visible. No charger or accessories are shown in any photo.

read_from: photo 1 back design: triple camera module, Apple logo, and space gray finish match iPhone 12 Pro

No video or photo shows the phone powered on or in use. No screen display is visible in any photo.
No charger or accessory is visible in any photo. The claim cannot be confirmed from the images.
